machine_label: Apple M4 Pro (14-core CPU, 48 GiB RAM)
notes: The public profile intentionally excludes serial numbers, hardware UUIDs, hostnames, and account names.
The exact OS and Python versions are captured separately in every immutable run specification.

The launcher records session power provenance and the controller probes an explicit power-mode tag, observation status, macOS Energy Mode label, raw pmset lowpowermode value, and probe errors immediately before and after every task.
Energy Mode never gates execution; an unavailable observation is explicitly tagged as unavailable rather than inferred.

Changing Energy Mode never changes the protocol fingerprint; every task retains both boundary observations so reports can identify single-mode, mixed-mode, unavailable-mode, and mixed-within-task results.
Operator-controlled settings are frozen in the profile but must still be confirmed before each uninterrupted machine run.
